title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent summaries for DLP alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR
summary: The briefing passes: its deployment controls, licensing, consumption meter and rollout targets are supported. Minor corrections should distinguish the planned preview rollout from confirmed delivery, acknowledge conflicting preview documentation about identity and roles, and remove a prerequisite checklist step without a matching control row.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to make Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations available on DLP alerts in Defender XDR.
claims.quote: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts will be made available in DLP Alerts in Microsoft Defender XDR.
